verdict.rationale: Docs show employees can view vested grants under My Equity, click Exercise Now, select share count, and sign exercise documents online (with spousal consent if needed), indicating a digital, paperless exercise workflow. However, evidence does not explicitly confirm the payment step (how exercise cost is collected) or confirm automated share issuance/cap table update post-exercise. missing for 10: explicit documentation of online payment processing during exercise, confirmation of automatic share issuance/cap table update, and independent/hands-on corroboration of the end-to-end flow.
